claims.disproof_condition: 條件：Corning 的 10-Q／10-K 或 8-K 寫出這份長期夥伴協議終止（Traditional Warrant 依條款隨協議終止而失效），或 NVIDIA 的申報寫出出售或註銷這批認股權證。核查頻率：每季（Corning 10-Q 的 Shareholders' Equity 附註）。觸發後 48 小時：e1 加註終止日期或降 confidence，重讀光纖層讀圖與 Corning 那幾條供貨邊的客戶端承諾。
claims.statement: Corning's Form 8-K of 2026-05-06 (Item 3.02): in connection with the long-term partnership with NVIDIA, Corning issued and sold to NVIDIA a warrant to purchase up to 15 million shares at $180.00 per share and a pre-funded warrant for up to 3 million shares at $0.0001, for an aggregate purchase price of $500 million. The joint press release (Exhibit 99.1) calls it a multiyear commercial and technology partnership to expand U.S.-based manufacturing of advanced optical connectivity. Minority, non-control stake; the filing gives no supply volume.

source_doc.permission_basis: SEC EDGAR 公開申報；只保留研究必要的有限逐字節錄。published_at 取申報日 2026-05-06（EDGAR submissions：8-K，items 3.02,7.01,9.01）。
source_doc.title: Corning 8-K（2026-05-06）第 3.02 項：與 NVIDIA 長期夥伴關係相關，賣給 NVIDIA 認股權證（1,500 萬股、行使價 180 美元）與預付型認股權證（300 萬股），合計價款 5 億美元；附 NVIDIA–Corning 聯合新聞稿

sources.locator: Form 8-K Item 3.02 Unregistered Sales of Equity Securities
sources.quote: On May 6, 2026, in connection with the long-term partnership with NVIDIA Corporation (“NVIDIA”) described in Item 7.01 below, Corning Incorporated (the “Company”) entered into a securities purchase agreement (the “Purchase Agreement”) with NVIDIA pursuant to which the Company issued and sold to NVIDIA (i) a warrant (the “Traditional Warrant”) to purchase up to 15 million shares of common stock of the Company, par value $0.50 per share (the “Common Stock”), at an exercise price of $180.00 per share, and (ii) a pre-funded warrant (the “Pre-Funded Warrant” and, together with the Traditional Warrant, the “Warrants”) to purchase up to 3 million shares of Common Stock at an exercise price of $0.0001 per share, for an aggregate purchase price of $500 million.

sources.locator: Exhibit 99.1 NVIDIA–Corning 聯合新聞稿（2026-05-06）首段
sources.quote: NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) and Corning Incorporated (NYSE: GLW) today announced a multiyear commercial and technology partnership to dramatically expand U.S.-based manufacturing of the advanced optical connectivity solutions needed to power next-generation AI infrastructure.
